==Differences between the animated series and the manga==
This chapter portrays the events of Ultra Exciting from the Shocking Start! and Trial on a Golden Scale! as happening simultaneously. 
As all of its previous appearances were skipped, Chloe's Eevee debuts here. 
and Volkner's is now a 2-vs-2. Ash's Gengar and Volkner's are omitted.
Goh never catches a or . Instead, they are driven off.
